dataset.source: ERA5 via Open-Meteo historical API (grid samples, converted units)
dataset.fog_quality: proxy: RH≥97% and low-cloud cover≥70%; visibility assumed 0.5 km
dataset.precipitation_quality: Open-Meteo hourly precipitation mm converted to m SWE; snowfall cm / 7 to mm SWE (fixed ratio), partitioned into rain and snow
